audit_meta.supersedes: previous audit dated 2026-07-28 (pre-merge, documentation-only repo state)
audit_meta.method: Derived from `git log --oneline main`, `git branch -a --sort=-committerdate`, `git status`, `gh pr list --state all`, `gh issue list --state all`, directory listings of supabase/migrations/ and supabase/tests/, `grep 'select plan('` for assertion counts, and an actual execution of scripts/run_db_tests.sh against PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS 3.4.2 + pgTAP 1.3.2. No status was inferred without one of these as backing.
audit_meta.what_changed_since_last_audit: The repo is no longer documentation-only. PR #1 and #2 are merged; main now carries 9 SQL migrations, a seed file, a reproducible test runner, and 32 passing pgTAP assertions. Two PRs are open.

assumed_vs_actual_flags.flag: CLAUDE.md still declares 'Current Build Mode — Mock UI First' and lists 'creating Supabase migrations' under Forbidden work — but 9 migrations are merged to main.
assumed_vs_actual_flags.evidence: CLAUDE.md lines 76-86 vs supabase/migrations/ on main @ bb00285.
assumed_vs_actual_flags.why_it_matters: Any future Claude Code or Codex session reads CLAUDE.md as authoritative and would be told the work already merged is forbidden. This is a live contradiction in the governing document, not a cosmetic one. Not fixed inline because CLAUDE.md rule 13 requires surgical changes scoped to the current task; flagged here instead.

assumed_vs_actual_flags.flag: All seeded data is placeholder and cannot be defended to a panel.
assumed_vs_actual_flags.evidence: supabase/seed.sql — both TODA polygons are invented axis-aligned rectangles; fare figures (P25/P15 base, P8/P5 per km) are invented.
assumed_vs_actual_flags.why_it_matters: The fare and geofence LOGIC is real and tested; the NUMBERS are not. ROADMAP Month 1 Week 3 covers replacing them.

assumed_vs_actual_flags.flag: Two PRs are open, not one.
assumed_vs_actual_flags.why_it_matters: If the intent was a single 'Code Review / Test' card, the board now shows two. PR #4 is documentation-only and cheap to merge.

assumed_vs_actual_flags.flag: ride_type remains the column/enum name while the table is now trips.
assumed_vs_actual_flags.why_it_matters: Renaming it requires a new migration against merged schema, so it was deliberately excluded from PR #4. Left as a known, documented inconsistency.

assumed_vs_actual_flags.flag: Zero GitHub issues exist, so the rubric's 'Sprint Planning' status is unreachable.
assumed_vs_actual_flags.why_it_matters: No unit can be classified Sprint Planning. Everything not backed by a branch or PR falls to Backlog. If issue-based planning is wanted, issues need creating first.

assumed_vs_actual_flags.flag: No Supabase project exists; the auth schema used by tests is a local shim.
assumed_vs_actual_flags.evidence: supabase/tests/00_bootstrap_local.sql, explicitly marked 'NOT A MIGRATION, NOT DEPLOYED'.
assumed_vs_actual_flags.why_it_matters: Migrations have never been applied to a real Supabase instance. auth.users/auth.uid() behaviour is emulated locally, so RLS policies are structurally present but not yet proven against real Supabase Auth.

assumed_vs_actual_flags.flag: No user story identifiers (US-01..US-05) exist anywhere in the repo.
